notes: the dash remark «- قال ابن أبي عمر حدثنا سفيان، -» repeats the first level in another form: left out (rule 1)
«مولى ابن عباس» describes Kurayb; the link is the second «ابن عباس» (occurrence 2)
Ibn Abbas tells his own night in the first person: he is the last link; Sufyan's comment after the saying is not a route
